trait Pick<F<_>> { fn pick<A> left: F<A> -> right: F<A> -> Bool }

struct Holder<G<_>, A> { value: G<A> }
instance Pick<Holder<Maybe>> {
 fn pick<A> left: Holder<Maybe, A> -> (Holder<Maybe, A> -> Bool) = \right -> True
}
fn selected<G<_>, A> left: Holder<G, A> -> (Holder<G, A> -> Bool) where Pick<Holder<G>> = {
 let chosen: Holder<G, A> -> Holder<G, A> -> Bool = pick
 chosen left
}
pub effect fn main = do {
 let value: Holder<Maybe, Int> = Holder { value: Just 1 }
 let saved = selected<Maybe, Int> value
 println (show (saved value))
}
